fixture_diagnosis.observed_failure: Integrated private chat runner rejected chat_set_reasoning(high) as unsupported_reasoning_effort after session lifecycle operations.
fixture_diagnosis.source_explanation: The private gate sets APIKey.text directly without emitting the native text_changed configuration event. The connection signature includes the API-key hash. The older initial catalog may therefore belong to the pre-edit signature; new session restore correctly refuses to reuse it under the changed key. LineEdit::set_text delegates to _set_text without emitting text_changed.
fixture_diagnosis.required_test_correction: In the private fixture, emit text_changed after setting the synthetic API key and wait for actual fresh reasoning/model capability advertisement, rather than only Send becoming enabled. This models the real native UI edit path, as upstream auto-fetch fixtures already do.
